radiology_report:
Department of Radiology
UMCG (Groningen)
Date: 20 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 86.0 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 4+4, PI-RADS 5
FINDINGS: Prostate volume measures 37.29 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal hypo-intense lesion in the left peripheral zone at the base, measuring approximately 18 mm in maximal diameter. Diffusion-weighted imaging shows marked restriction within this region, with corresponding low apparent diffusion coefficient values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences reveal early and intense focal enhancement in the same area. No evidence of extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is seen.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone at the base. PSA density 2.306 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT2. csPCa predicted probability 0.9527162.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text: 10 May 2024 - Dr. R. van den Berg (GP): Patient presented with a PSA of 8.4 ng/mL, following a significant rise from 19.4 ng/mL in March 2023. A repeat biopsy was performed, which confirmed the prior Gleason 4+4 diagnosis. The patient was advised to continue with urological follow-up for treatment planning.

previous_notes.author: Dr. R. van den Berg (GP)
previous_notes.text: 16 Jan 2023 - Dr. R. van den Berg (GP): Initial PSA screening revealed a value of 19.4 ng/mL, markedly elevated from the baseline of 4.4 ng/mL in April 2022. A transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy was recommended to investigate the cause of the rapid PSA velocity. The patient was referred to urology for further evaluation.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1: Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 4+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 4. The tumour is located at the base, left. A cribriform pattern is present within the malignant glands.
Summary: The biopsy findings demonstrate a high-grade adenocarcinoma with cribriform features, consistent with the clinical suspicion of aggressive disease.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 5.
